Name: Drift
Tagline: Wallpaper that reflects the world around you
Description: Drift is a living wallpaper for Mac. It paints slow, moving gradients on your desktop that shift with the time of day and your local weather: warm light at sunset, rain, snow and storms when they arrive. Start with one of our nine beautiful palettes or generate your own. Turn on Real Sky to match the light and weather conditions outside your window. It runs as your real wallpaper on every display, and as your screen saver too. Free for 14 days. Launch price $12/year until December 18, then $15.

Name: SparrowDesk Phone Calls
Tagline: Phone support in the same inbox as email, chat & WhatsApp
Description: Phone support inside your helpdesk. SparrowDesk Phone Calls puts calls in the same inbox as email, chat and WhatsApp. Buy a number in 51 countries, route callers with a visual IVR or an AI agent, and answer from the browser. Every call is recorded, transcribed and handled like any other ticket. No per-seat voice fees: pay as you go from a prepaid Voice Wallet.

Name: distribution.dev
Tagline: Advertise to developers on many sites with one campaign
Description: Anyone can build a product now, so the hard part is getting people to see it. distribution.dev is an ad network for developers, built by the publishers themselves: daily.dev and DEV (dev.to), together among the largest developer content platforms in the world. You set up one campaign and it runs on many developer sites at once, with ads made to fit in on each one.

Name: Pinned
Tagline: Ask the city where to go tonight with your friends
Topics: Android, Social Network, Artificial Intelligence, Maps
Description: Ask Pinned where to go tonight, the way you'd text a friend who knows the city. Pinned AI reads every spot nearby and brings back the three that fit your whole crew, with a reason for each. Then drop a pin with the plan, and your friends say "I'm down" in one tap. Try a real Ask at pinned.social, no download needed. Free on iPhone and Android, made in New York for people who'd rather be out than online.

Name: doola MCP
Tagline: Start and run your US company from your AI assistant
Description: The doola MCP lets founders start and run a US company from ChatGPT, Claude, and any tool that supports MCP. Form an LLC or C-Corp in any of the 50 states in one chat, from account setup to submission. Already a doola customer? Connect your account and ask your AI Co-Founder for your EIN letter, formation documents and deadlines. doola Bookkeeping customers can also pull financial reports, and connected Shopify or ad accounts add sales and ad spend trends. Add mcp.doola.com as a connector.

Name: Kodak SlideTag
Tagline: A 1935 film-slide E-Ink frame that tracks like an AirTag
Description: Inspired by vintage Kodachrome slide mounts, Kodak SlideTag is a tiny photo display with a six-color E Ink screen you can update from your phone. It doubles as a tracker for Apple Find My or Google Find Hub and comes in $34.99 blind boxes.

Name: frwrd.to
Tagline: Your link in bio, sorted by your AI in one message
Topics: Social Media, Artificial Intelligence, Social media marketing
Description: Send your AI assistant your current link in bio or your website. It keeps what matters, matches your brand and publishes the page in every language you need. Campaigns end on their own, and you can edit everything by hand too.

Name: Granular.Build
Tagline: Put your AI agents to work in a visual workspace
Description: Big ideas shouldn't require a dozen AI tools or a programming background. Granular brings your models, agents, files, and project context into one visual workspace. Give a boss agent your goal, let it coordinate specialists in parallel, and watch apps, designs, or videos take shape with live previews. Bring your own AI, use built-in terminals and plugins when you need them, and keep each project's memory and files in one place. Go from first plan to published result.

Name: Clam AI
Tagline: Your inbox, safely shared with AI agents
Description: Your inbox is a master key: password resets, bank alerts and health reports all run through it. Clam lets AI agents work in your email without holding that key. You write the rules in plain English, like "Read travel email. Draft replies. Never send." Each agent sees and does only what its rules allow, and you see everything it tries. We start with Gmail. We are building the permission layer for MCP: one that understands what the data means and the context of every request.

Name: Willow iOS 2.0
Tagline: No switching apps while you dictate
Description: Tap the mic and talk without leaving the app you’re writing in. Willow brings dictation and Scribe into your iPhone keyboard, alongside swipe typing, smarter autocorrect, emoji, and cursor control. Speak a longer thought, type a quick edit, and keep going.

Name: Claude Ship
Tagline: Ship code as fast as you can write it
Description: Ship code as fast as you can write it: Claude Ship reviews, fixes, and approves pull requests, taking each one from opened to ready to merge. Code Review posts verified findings on each PR. PR Steward (beta) fixes failing CI, conflicts, and review feedback, but never merges. Claude Approvals (beta) approves routine changes under your team's policy file and asks a human about the rest. Run /ship in Claude Code to push, open the PR, and hand it off. For Claude Team and Enterprise on GitHub.

Name: Ohhai
Tagline: Type messy, send clean: an AI keyboard for iPhone
Description: Ohhai is an AI keyboard for iPhone. Type fast, mistakes and all, and Return puts in the clean phrase. Or talk, or translate into over 40 languages, in any app. Stuck on a reply? Press the Action Button for three drafts. You always press send.

Name: Fleetify
Tagline: Open-source command center for your AI coding agents
Topics: Open Source, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub
Description: Fleetify is a free, open-source desktop app for running AI coding agents side by side. Start sessions with Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and seven more agents, or with OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenRouter and local Ollama models. Watch them all from the Fleet hub: status, spend, tokens and live activity. Give each task its own git worktree, preview your dev server, open PRs, and install a plugin once for every agent that supports it. macOS, Windows, Linux.

Name: Astrolabio
Tagline: Your AIs pick up right where you left off, on your Mac
Description: Every new AI chat starts from scratch. Astrolabio keeps a notebook for each project: status, decisions, rules, to-dos. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and Antigravity read it on their own and keep it updated. Stays on your Mac.

Name: Astor
Tagline: AI Thesis Investing
Description: Astor is the personal investing agent for thesis-driven investors. Tell Astor what you believe in, e.g. “the grid is AI’s bottleneck.” Astor builds the portfolio and explains every pick. It monitors your thesis every market day, and when the story changes, it tells you how to adjust. You approve every trade. Free to start.

Name: Tendor
Tagline: Write it or ask it, from anywhere on Windows
Description: Write down a thought or ask AI without leaving what you're doing. Press a hotkey and Tendor opens over any app on Windows 11. Type to save a task or note, start with ? to ask AI, or ?! to send your screen too. The AI reads your tasks and notes from any day, asking before it opens an older one. Save instructions as Skills and run them with /name, or type /newskill and the AI writes one. Use your own key from 8 providers. Plain Markdown, no account, free to start.

Name: Rotara
Tagline: Mac workspaces, one flick away
Description: Each project gets its own windows. Switch and only that project is on screen, every window exactly where you left it, and Dock clicks and links open right there. A pie menu opens at your cursor and one flick takes you there, or use ⌃1–9 or a swipe. ⌘Tab shows only this project's apps and the pie sits on keys you already press, so it feels like part of macOS. Nothing to set up. 14 days free, then $19 once.

Name: mindyOne
Tagline: Your Instagram DMs. Now with an AI receptionist.
Description: mindyOne is an AI receptionist for your Instagram DMs. When someone asks for a time, it answers from your prices and hours, offers only slots that are really free, and books the appointment right in the chat: a name, a read-back and a yes. It also reschedules and cancels, says it's an AI, and steps back when you reply. Built for businesses whose DMs end in a booking: trainers, salons, photographers, studios, consultants. Build yours from a description and talk to it before you sign up.

Name: Valley
Tagline: Outbound system to find people most likely to buy from you
Description: Valley finds the people most likely to buy from you, from live buying signals, plain-English search or your own lists. It checks each one against your ICP, researches them, and writes a personal message across LinkedIn and email. You approve every message, replies land in one inbox, and it runs from Claude or ChatGPT via MCP. Teams see 15-45% reply rates vs about 2% for cold outreach. Bolt.new booked 25 enterprise demos in 45 days. Book a demo to see it on your own leads.

Name: K-Stra
Tagline: Geomarketing for Australia, with an AI that does the maths
Description: Where should we open next? K-Stra answers that for retailers, franchise networks and property teams in Australia. Give it an address and it draws the real drive-time catchment, then shows who lives there, what they earn and spend, which competitors are nearby, what property costs and an estimate of road and foot traffic. An AI assistant sets up the analysis from a plain-English question and shows the price in credits before anything runs. Free to explore, no subscription required.
